newsitem.title: USA: Digital Q4 EPS cut by PaineWebber.
newsitem.headline: Digital Q4 EPS cut by PaineWebber.

text.p: PaineWebber analyst Stephen Smith said he cut his fourth quarter earnings estimates to $0.60 a share, from $0.70 a share previously.
Smith said that Digital is expected to have an even bigger impact from currency in the fourth quarter and sales of its Alpha-based systems were disappointing in the third quarter.
Earlier, Digital told reporters on a conference call that currency will also hurt its fourth quarter net income.
Smith said that on a year-over-year basis, sales of Digital's Alpha business was down about 13 percent.

"They are not out in front with leadership like they were a year ago," Smith said. "The next machines are coming out next year and on top of that they are not as good at marketing as their competitors."
Smith said that Digital forecast on the analyst conference call "mid to high single-digit" sequential revenue growth for the fourth quarter, versus the third quarter.

Digital reported earnings of $0.27 a share, which was better than the Wall Street consensus estimate of $0.24 a share. Smith said that the stock was likely up because some investors were expecting Digital have a worse quarter.
